history.suggestion: One prioritized plan: (1) Fit the centerpiece — tighten row spacing and node diameter ~10%, or wrap the tree in a scroll/zoom canvas with edge fades and +/− controls; give the sidebar its own scroll with a bottom fade so Attributes never clip.
